newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares ease but mood still positive.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares ease but mood still positive.

text.p: 1205 GMT - Shares were easing overall with some continued profit-taking on selected shares but the mood remains positive and the trend could change during the session, traders said.
*Portugal Telecom was slightly firmer, boosted by the strong dollar, and Inparsa and Sonae Industria were also gaining against the tide.
*But the telecommunications stock was still below its close in New York on Friday in what was taken as a sign of the market's general apathy.
*The market showed no reaction to the better than expected inflation figures for June as investors have already discounted that inflation is slowing in Portugal, traders said.
*Traders said that the strength of the dollar should help underpin prices, particularly of those shares most exposed to foreign investment.
